title: artemisia marschalliana var. tschernieviana
intro: Artemisia marschalliana var. tschernieviana, commonly known as Russian wormwood, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to Central Asia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Russian wormwood include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
